subject: StrataGrid: Tenant isolation & telemetry evidence timeline
body:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@stratagrid.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chan <olivia.chan@auditcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant isolation & telemetry evidence — quick clarifications

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Security and our auditors need a compact deliverable we can include with the SIG packet: specific evidence showing tenant isolation (network, compute, and caching), and a sample of telemetry logs that demonstrate request tracing and retention behavior.

Can you confirm:
- Whether tenant KV-caches are physically isolated or logically namespaced?
- Typical telemetry retention for trace/span data and token-level request logs for hosted customers?
- If you can provide a short manifest of artifacts you will deliver and an estimated ETA (we are targeting to include the materials in our vendor-review on Feb 8).

Appreciate a concrete list and files we can attach to our RFP response.

Best,
Tom
Head of Procurement — StrataGrid

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@stratagrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant isolation & telemetry evidence — quick clarifications

Tom,

Great question — below is a compact mapping and delivery plan. Looping in Kimberly (Security) and Neha (Evidence) to produce the artifacts. High-level answers first, then the planned deliverables and ETA.

Short answers:
- KV cache model: logical namespacing per tenant with enforced namespace keys at runtime; for Dedicated and Private deployments we can provide physically separated cache instances. For Hosted customers we enforce strict namespace isolation plus encryption-at-rest and per-tenant access controls.
- Telemetry retention: by default hosted traces/spans are kept 30 days, aggregated telemetry (metrics) 90 days; raw request logs (token-level) are retained 7 days unless a customer opts into extended retention under contract. Private/Dedicated options can be configured per SLA.

Planned deliverables (we will attach files and short statements):
1) Tenant isolation architecture diagram (attachment) — shows network, runtime, and cache namespacing.
2) Control mapping CSV (SIG controls -> Redwood artifacts) — includes control IDs, description, and artifact pointers.
3) Telemetry sample (sanitized log sample) — redacted token data but includes trace IDs, timestamps, and sampling rate.
4) Evidence manifest (zip) — links to the above plus timestamps and contact owners.

ETA: Neha and team can assemble the initial package by Wed Jan 27 EOD PST. If you need earlier, we can prioritize the architecture diagram and mapping CSV for delivery by Mon Jan 25.

Steps needed from you: please confirm which level of detail is allowed in the RFP attachment (full sanitized logs vs. aggregated samples). Auditors sometimes push back on even redacted token excerpts.

Priyom
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@stratagrid.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant isolation & telemetry evidence — quick clarifications

Tom — adding a couple of security specifics and the evidence approach. Olivia, copying you as audit lead.

Security specifics:
- Cache isolation: hosted uses strict logical namespacing plus runtime enforcement (namespace tokens on all cache ops). We perform periodic fuzz testing to confirm no cross-namespace leakage. Dedicated appliances can be configured with separate cache clusters per tenant on request.
- Keying and KMS: encryption-at-rest keys for caches are customer-segmented; hosted customers can use Redwood-managed keys or bring-your-own (BYOK) via KMS.
- Network segmentation: control-plane APIs are multi-tenant but data-plane paths for inference are routed to isolated worker pools based on tenant tag and policy to minimize blast radius.

Evidence approach (what we'll include in the packet):
- tenant-isolation-arch.pdf: annotated architecture diagram with callouts for enforcement points.
- sig_control_mapping.csv: control-to-evidence crosswalk (SOC2/ISO/SIG rows).
- kv-cache-telemetry-sample.log: 1 hour of sanitized telemetry showing trace ids, request size, cache hit/miss events.
- evidence_manifest.zip: README.md plus checksums and owner contacts for each artifact.

Privacy note: logs will be redacted to remove any PII or customer identifiers; we will provide the redaction methodology in the manifest.

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead — Redwood Inference

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@stratagrid.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jan 2027 11:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant isolation & telemetry evidence — compact delivery plan

Tom / team,

We have assembled the initial artifacts. Quick delivery notes and how to interpret the files: see attached manifest and short guidance below.

Artifact summary:
- tenant-isolation-arch.pdf (attached): single-page, annotated architecture. Use this for your RFP schematic.
- sig_control_mapping.csv (attached): CSV columns: control_id, standard, redwood_artifact_ref, evidence_file, cust_note.
- kv-cache-telemetry-sample.log (attached): sanitized; contains a sampling of 6 request traces demonstrating namespace enforcement and cache hit/miss markers (cache_namespace="sg-tenant-xx" is replaced with placeholder 'tenant-N').
- evidence_manifest.zip (attached): compressed package with README, checksums, redaction log (redaction-run-20270126.txt), and owner contact list.

Delivery cadence:
- Jan 27 EOD PST: full zip (evidence_manifest.zip) to your secure ShareFolder link (we uploaded to the Drive URL in the related links).
- If AuditCorp needs a live walkthrough of the artifacts, Kimberly and I can run a 45-minute session the week of Jan 31.

Notes on the telemetry sample: the sample was generated in a 1-hour window from our staging ingestion pipeline with production-like load. Token strings have been replaced with deterministic hashes; trace IDs preserved for sequencing. Retention defaults described earlier are accurate for hosted accounts; we will include contract language options for extended retention.

If you confirm the Drive link is acceptable for inclusion in your packet, we'll proceed with delivery.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Evidence Operations — Redwood Inference

---

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@stratagrid.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jan 2027 15:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant isolation & telemetry evidence — compact delivery plan

Team — this is perfect, thank you. The Drive link and the zip will be attached to the RFP appendix. Two quick asks before we close the loop: 1) a one-paragraph statement we can include in the vendor pack that summarizes tenant isolation guarantees (we prefer something we can paste as-is), and 2) confirmation that the sample telemetry is representative (Olivia — audit team — will validate but it looks right at first pass).

If you can send the 1-paragraph statement today we will include it. Otherwise, we'll accept the artifact bundle and schedule the walkthrough with Kimberly/Neha next week.

Thanks,
Tom

[Attachment stubs: tenant-isolation-arch.pdf (PDF), kv-cache-telemetry-sample.log (text), sig_control_mapping.csv (CSV), evidence_manifest.zip (zip)]
